children: Construction Partners completed acquisition of Asphalt Express, adding liquid asphalt supply and transportation assets in Oklahoma and North Texas.
Acquired Asphalt Express Enterprises, a liquid asphalt supply and hauling business serving Oklahoma and northern Texas.
Overland Corporation bought Asphalt Express’s rail-served Ardmore site to support future liquid asphalt terminal plans.
Transaction includes a fleet of trucks and trailers to bolster CPI’s liquid asphalt transportation capabilities.
Move strengthens vertical integration, improving access, sourcing flexibility and support for regional asphalt operations.
